title: Describe a hosted read failure
responsibility: Turns a failed hosted response into a bounded public error without repeating arbitrary server prose.

inputs.name: hostedPublicFailure.response
inputs.description: The Response whose status selects the public failure state and whose bounded body may supply a public error code. The function requests at most 4,096 bytes through hostedResponse.

outputs.name: hostedPublicFailure
outputs.description: A promise resolving to a HostedFailureValidator instance: status 401 or 403 produces state denied, and every other status produces failed. Its message includes a parsed string error only when that code is allowlisted; otherwise it reports the HTTP status without exposing server prose.
